PDF Real-Time Light Transport in Analytically Integrable Participating Media
The existing real-time approaches are mostly based on empirical or single-scattering approximations, or only consider homogeneous media. This work briefly examines the existing solutions and then presents an improved method for real-time multiple scattering in quasi-heterogeneous media.
